diagnosis: The scenario fails because the model can satisfy checks C1, C2, C6, and C7 using only public information. Specifically, the model defaults to 'voluntary_self_disclosure' (C1, C2) and 'continue_direct_only' (C6, C7) as generic risk-mitigation responses to the shared anomaly S1, without needing the specific details in PF2 or PF3.

C1.why: The absence of regulator contact does not identify a filing path or screening duration; PF2 changes the response to an OFAC filing expressly labeled voluntary_self_disclosure with exactly 6 months of enhanced screening.

C2.why: The absence of regulator contact does not identify a filing path or screening duration; PF2 changes the response to an OFAC filing expressly labeled voluntary_self_disclosure with exactly 6 months of enhanced screening.

C6.why: The distributor's commercial importance alone does not determine its operating terms; PF3 changes the plan to continue the distributor only under direct invoicing with intermediary payments stopped and requires a matching direct-invoicing commitment.

C7.why: The distributor's commercial importance alone does not determine its operating terms; PF3 changes the plan to continue the distributor only under direct invoicing with intermediary payments stopped and requires a matching direct-invoicing commitment.
